title: Sutra-khanda, part 4 (portion 04)
html:
Narada parts from Uddhava and comes to Kailasa; Narada's account of the mahaprasada: Uddhava's words on the remnants of the Lord's meal, Narada's service to Lakshmi, the dance of Shiva after tasting mahaprasada, the Earth's complaint; Parvati's vow to give mahaprasada to all living beings; the Lord of Vaikuntha approves her vow and promises to appear in the Kali-yuga as Gaura

জুড়াইল দেহ মোর তোমার সম্ভাষে ।
চলিলা নারদ বীণা বাজাঞা উল্লাসে ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

juṛāila deha mora tomāra sambhāṣe |
calilā nārada bīṇā bājāñā ullāse || 154 ||

judaila — was soothed; deha mora — my body; tomara sambhashe — by your words; chalila narada — Narada went; vina bajana — playing the vina; ullase — joyfully

154You have refreshed my very body with your words"; —
and Narada went on, rejoicing, playing his vina.

জৈমিনিভারতে নারদ-উদ্ধব-সংবাদ ।
শুনিঞা লোচনদাসের আনন্দ-উন্মাদ ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

jaiminibhārate nārada-uddhaba-saṃbāda |
śuniñā locanadāsera ānanda-unmāda || 155 ||

jaimini-bharate — in the Jaimini-bharata; narada-uddhava-samvada — the dialogue of Narada and Uddhava; shuniya — hearing; lochanadasera — Lochana Dasa's; ananda-unmada — frenzy of joy

155The dialogue of Narada and Uddhava from the Jaimini-bharata —
hearing it, Lochana Dasa is mad with joy.

আমার বচনে যে বা প্রতীত না যায় ।
বিচার করুক পুথি বত্রিশ অধ্যায় ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

āmāra bacane ye bā pratīta nā yāẏa |
bicāra karuka puthi batriśa adhyāẏa || 156 ||

amara bachane — my words; ye ba — whoever; pratita na yaya — does not believe; vichara karuka — let him examine; puthi — the book; batrisha adhyaya — the thirty-second chapter

156Whoever does not believe my words,
let him examine the book — the thirty-second chapter.1

Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Ah, my life — Gorachand!"

চলিলা নারদমুনি বীণা গায় গুণ ।
শুনিঞা বিহ্বল হিয়া পড়ে পুনঃপুনঃ ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

calilā nāradamuni bīṇā gāẏa guṇa |
śuniñā bihbala hiẏā paṛe punaḥpunaḥ || 157 ||

chalila naradamuni — the sage Narada went on; vina gaya guna — the vina sings [His] virtues; shuniya — hearing; vihvala hiya — his heart overwhelmed; pade punah-punah — he falls again and again

157The sage Narada goes on, and his vina sings [His] virtues;
hearing it, his heart overwhelmed, he falls again and again.

ক্ষণেক রোদন ক্ষণে অট্ট অট্ট হাস ।
ক্ষণে কাঁপে ক্ষণে ক্ষণে আধ আধ ভাষ ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

kṣaṇeka rodana kṣaṇe aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsa |
kṣaṇe kāṁpe kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ādha ādha bhāṣa || 158 ||

kshaneka rodana — now weeping; kshane atta atta hasa — now loud laughter; kshane kampe — now he trembles; kshane kshane — at moments; adha adha bhasha — half-uttered words

158Now he weeps, now laughs aloud,
now trembles, now stammers in half-words;

ক্ষণে হুহুঙ্কার ছাড়ে মারে মালসাট ।
গোরা গোরা বলি কান্দে অন্তরে উচাট ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

kṣaṇe huhuṅkāra chāṛe māre mālasāṭa |
gorā gorā bali kānde antare ucāṭa || 159 ||

kshane huhunkara chhade — now he roars; mare malasata — slaps his arms like a wrestler; gora gora bali — crying "Gora, Gora"; kande — he weeps; antare uchata — restless at heart

159now he roars and slaps his arms like a wrestler;2
crying "Gora, Gora!" he weeps, his heart restless.

পাশরিতে নারে গোরার সুমধুর প্রেম ।
অঙ্গ ঝলমল তেজ দিনকর যেন ॥ ১৬০ ॥

pāśarite nāre gorāra sumadhura prema |
aṅga jhalamala teja dinakara yena || 160 ||

pasharite nare — he cannot forget; gorara sumadhura prema — Gora's sweetest prema; anga jhalamala — his body blazes; teja — with radiance; dinakara yena — like the sun

160He cannot forget Gora's sweetest prema;
his body blazes with radiance like the sun.

চলিতে না পারে প্রেমে অন্তর-উল্লাস ।
আঁখির নিমিখে গেলা শিবের কৈলাস ॥ ১৬১ ॥

calite nā pāre preme antara-ullāsa |
āṁkhira nimikhe gelā śibera kailāsa || 161 ||

chalite na pare — he cannot walk; preme — from prema; antara-ullasa — joy within; akhira nimikhe — in the twinkling of an eye; gela shivera kailasa — he reached Shiva's Kailasa

161For prema he cannot walk, his heart exults —
and in the twinkling of an eye he was at Shiva's Kailasa.

মহেশ দেখিব বলি বাড়িল আনন্দ ।
কহিব কৃষ্ণের কথা করিয়া প্রবন্ধ ॥ ১৬২ ॥

maheśa dekhiba bali bāṛila ānanda |
kahiba kṛṣṇera kathā kariẏā prabandha || 162 ||

mahesha dekhiba bali — thinking "I shall see Mahesha"; badila ananda — his joy grew; kahiba krishnera katha — "I shall tell of Krishna"; kariya prabandha — in a well-ordered account

162"I shall see Mahesha!" — and his joy grew:
"I shall tell him of Krishna, all in due order.

এছন আনন্দ-কথা নাহি তিনলোকে ।
বৃন্দাবন-ধন প্রকাশিব কলিযুগে ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

echana ānanda-kathā nāhi tinaloke |
bṛndābana-dhana prakāśiba kaliyuge || 163 ||

echhana ananda-katha — such joyful news; nahi tina-loke — is not in the three worlds; vrindavana-dhana — the treasure of Vrindavana; prakashiba — He will reveal; kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga

163There is no such joyful news in the three worlds:
the treasure of Vrindavana [the Lord] will reveal in the Kali-yuga;

যে প্রেম যাচয়ে শিব বিরিঞ্চি অনন্ত ।
তাহা বিলসিব কলি অধম দুরন্ত ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

ye prema yācaẏe śiba biriñci ananta |
tāhā bilasiba kali adhama duranta || 164 ||

ye prema yachaye — the prema begged for by; shiva virinchi ananta — Shiva, Brahma, Ananta; taha vilasiba — that will be enjoyed by; kali — [the people of] Kali; adhama duranta — the fallen and wild

164the prema for which Shiva, Brahma and Ananta pray
the fallen and unruly [people] of Kali will enjoy.

হেন অদভুত কথা কহিব মহেশে ।
শুনিঞা ঠাকুর পাবে বড়ই সন্তোষে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

hena adabhuta kathā kahiba maheśe |
śuniñā ṭhākura pābe baṛai santoṣe || 165 ||

hena adabhuta katha — such wondrous news; kahiba maheshe — I shall tell Mahesha; shuniya — hearing; thakura — the lord; pabe badai santoshe — will be greatly pleased

165I shall tell Mahesha this wondrous news —
hearing it, the lord will be greatly pleased.

কাত্যায়নী-প্রসাদ লইব পদধূলি ।
যাঁর পদ-পরসাদে হরিনাম বলি ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

kātyāẏanī-prasāda laiba padadhūli |
yāṁra pada-parasāde harināma bali || 166 ||

katyayani-prasada — Katyayani's grace; laiba pada-dhuli — I shall take, the dust of [her] feet; yara pada-parasade — by the grace of whose feet; hari-nama bali — I utter Hari's name

166By Katyayani's grace I shall take the dust of her feet —
by the grace of [those] feet I utter Hari's name."3

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে গেলা মহেশের দ্বার ।
সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা দেখি নন্দী মহাকাল ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

cintite cintite gelā maheśera dbāra |
sambhrame uṭhilā dekhi nandī mahākāla || 167 ||

chintite chintite — musing thus; gela maheshera dvara — he came to Mahesha's gate; sambhrame uthila — rose respectfully; dekhi — seeing [him]; nandi mahakala — Nandi and Mahakala

167Musing thus, he came to Mahesha's gate;
seeing him, Nandi and Mahakala rose respectfully.4

পরণাম করি নন্দী গেলা অভ্যন্তরে ।
পার্বতী-মহেশ যথা নিজ অন্তঃপুরে ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

paraṇāma kari nandī gelā abhyantare |
pārbatī-maheśa yathā nija antaḥpure || 168 ||

paranama kari — bowing; nandi gela abhyantare — Nandi went inside; parvati-mahesha yatha — where Parvati and Mahesha were; nija antahpure — in their inner apartments

168Bowing, Nandi went inside,
where Parvati and Mahesha were in their inner apartments,

জানাইলা দ্বারেতে নারদ-আগমন ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে দোঁহে চলিলা তখন ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

jānāilā dbārete nārada-āgamana |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe doṁhe calilā takhana || 169 ||

janaila — he announced; dvarete narada-agamana — Narada's arrival at the gate; ananda-hridaye — with joyful hearts; donhe chalila — both went; takhana — at once

169and announced that Narada was at the gate;
both came out at once with joyful hearts.

নারদ দেখিয়া হাসি সম্ভাষে ঠাকুর ।
চরণে পড়িলা মুনি ভক্ত সুচতুর ॥ ১৭০ ॥

nārada dekhiẏā hāsi sambhāṣe ṭhākura |
caraṇe paṛilā muni bhakta sucatura || 170 ||

narada dekhiya — seeing Narada; hasi sambhashe thakura — the lord greets [him] smiling; charane padila muni — the sage fell at his feet; bhakta suchatura — the wise devotee

170Seeing Narada, the lord greets him with a smile;
the sage, a wise devotee, fell at his feet.

মহেশ বিশেষ জানে বৈষ্ণবমহিমা ।
নারদে গৌরব করে প্রকাশিয়া প্রেমা ॥ ১৭১ ॥

maheśa biśeṣa jāne baiṣṇabamahimā |
nārade gauraba kare prakāśiẏā premā || 171 ||

mahesha vishesha jane — Mahesha especially knows; vaishnava-mahima — the greatness of Vaishnavas; narade gaurava kare — he honours Narada; prakashiya prema — showing love

171Mahesha, like no other, knows the greatness of Vaishnavas:
showing his love, he honours Narada.

গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন করি বসাইলা পাশে ।
চরণে পড়িয়া মুনি দেবীকে সম্ভাষে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

gāṛha āliṅgana kari basāilā pāśe |
caraṇe paṛiẏā muni debīke sambhāṣe || 172 ||

gadha alingana kari — embracing [him] tightly; basaila pashe — he seated [him] beside; charane padiya — falling at her feet; muni devike sambhashe — the sage greets the goddess

172Embracing him tightly, he seated him beside himself;
the sage, falling at the goddess's feet, greets her.

করে ধরি লৈয়া গেলা নারদ তপোধনে ।
গৌরব করিয়া দিল বসিতে আসনে ॥ ১৭২+১ ॥

kare dhari laiẏā gelā nārada tapodhane |
gauraba kariẏā dila basite āsane || 172+1 ||

kare dhari — taking by the hand; laiya gela — led (the subject is not named); narada tapodhane — Narada, rich in austerity; gaurava kariya — with honour; dila vasite asane — seated [him] on a seat

172+1Narada, rich in austerity, was taken by the hand and led,
and with honour seated on a seat.5

পুত্রস্নেহে নারদেরে পুছে কাত্যায়নী ।
কুশল মঙ্গল কহ প্রিয় মহামুনি ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

putrasnehe nāradere puche kātyāẏanī |
kuśala maṅgala kaha priẏa mahāmuni || 173 ||

putra-snehe — with a mother's affection; naradere puchhe katyayani — Katyayani asks Narada; kushala mangala kaha — tell of your welfare; priya mahamuni — dear great sage

173With a mother's tenderness Katyayani asks Narada:
"Tell me of your welfare, dear great sage.

চতুর্দশভুবনের তুমি তত্ত্ব জান ।
আজি কোথা হৈতে তব শুভ আগমন ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

caturdaśabhubanera tumi tattba jāna |
āji kothā haite taba śubha āgamana || 174 ||

chaturdasha-bhuvanera — of the fourteen worlds; tumi tattva jana — you know the truth; aji kotha haite — from where today; taba shubha agamana — your auspicious coming

174You know the truth of the fourteen worlds;
from where have you come today — to our good fortune?"

নারদ কহয়ে—শুন অদভুত কথা ।
জগত-নিস্তার-হেতু তুমি মাতাপিতা ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

nārada kahaẏe—śuna adabhuta kathā |
jagata-nistāra-hetu tumi mātāpitā || 175 ||

narada kahaye — Narada says; shuna adabhuta katha — hear wondrous news; jagata-nistara-hetu — for the deliverance of the world; tumi mata-pita — you are mother and father

175Narada says: "Hear wondrous news;
you are mother and father, [come] for the deliverance of the world.

পুরুব-রহস্য-কথা পাশরিলে তুমি ।
চরণে ধরিয়া এবে স্মরাইব আমি ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

puruba-rahasya-kathā pāśarile tumi |
caraṇe dhariẏā ebe smarāiba āmi || 176 ||

puruba-rahasya-katha — the former secret; pasharile tumi — you have forgotten; charane dhariya — clasping your feet; ebe smaraiba ami — now I shall remind [you]

176You have forgotten a former secret;
clasping your feet, I shall now remind you of it.

আদ্যোপান্ত যত কথা কহি তব স্থানে ।
শুনিঞা প্রসাদ মোরে করিবে আপনে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

ādyopānta yata kathā kahi taba sthāne |
śuniñā prasāda more karibe āpane || 177 ||

adyopanta yata katha — all from beginning to end; kahi taba sthane — I tell you; shuniya — having heard; prasada more karibe apane — you yourself will show me grace

177I shall tell you everything from beginning to end;
having heard it, you yourself will show me grace.

প্রভুরে পুরুবে কিছু পুছিল উদ্ধব ।
তব অন্তর্ধানে কিবা পৃথিবী রহিব ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

prabhure purube kichu puchila uddhaba |
taba antardhāne kibā pṛthibī rahiba || 178 ||

prabhure — the Lord; purube — formerly; kichhu puchhila uddhava — Uddhava asked something; taba antardhane — at Your disappearance; kiba prithivi rahiba — will the earth remain

178Once Uddhava asked the Lord:
'When You withdraw from sight, will the earth remain?

ভকত রহিব কিবা এই মহীমাঝে ।
শুনিঞা ঠাকুর যোগ কহে নিজ কাজে ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

bhakata rahiba kibā ei mahīmājhe |
śuniñā ṭhākura yoga kahe nija kāje || 179 ||

bhakata rahiba kiba — will devotees remain; ei mahi-majhe — on this earth; shuniya — hearing; thakura — the Lord; yoga kahe — expounds yoga; nija kaje — concerning His own workings

179Will devotees remain on this earth?'
Hearing this, the Thakura explained to him the yoga of what He Himself is:6

আমি জল আমি স্থল আমি মহী বৃক্ষ ।
আমি দেব গন্ধর্ব আমি যক্ষ রক্ষ ॥ ১৮০ ॥

āmi jala āmi sthala āmi mahī bṛkṣa |
āmi deba gandharba āmi yakṣa rakṣa || 180 ||

ami jala — I am water; ami sthala — I am land; ami mahi vriksha — I am earth and trees; ami deva gandharva — I am gods and gandharvas; ami yaksha raksha — I am yakshas and rakshasas

180'I am water, I am land, I am earth and trees,
I am gods and gandharvas, I am yakshas and rakshasas;

উৎপত্তি প্রলয় আমি সর্বজীব-প্রাণ ।
আমি সর্বময় আমার কাঁহা অন্তর্ধান ॥ ১৮১ ॥

utpatti pralaẏa āmi sarbajība-prāṇa |
āmi sarbamaẏa āmāra kāṁhā antardhāna || 181 ||

utpatti pralaya ami — I am origin and dissolution; sarvajiva-prana — the life of all beings; ami sarvamaya — I am all-pervading; amara kanha antardhana — where is My disappearance?

181I am origin and dissolution, the life of all beings;
I pervade all — how can I vanish?'7

এছন ঠাকুর-বাণী শুনিঞা উদ্ধব ।
বুকে কর হানি কহে নিজ অনুভব ॥ ১৮২ ॥

echana ṭhākura-bāṇī śuniñā uddhaba |
buke kara hāni kahe nija anubhaba || 182 ||

echhana thakura-vani — such words of the Lord; shuniya uddhava — hearing, Uddhava; buke kara hani — striking his breast with his hand; kahe nija anubhava — speaks his own realization

182Hearing such words of the Thakura, Uddhava,
striking his breast with his hand, speaks his own realization:

তুমি সর্বময় প্রভু—আমি ইহা জানি ।
তোমার অধিক তোর পদ দুইখানি ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

tumi sarbamaẏa prabhu—āmi ihā jāni |
tomāra adhika tora pada duikhāni || 183 ||

tumi sarvamaya prabhu — You are the all-pervading Lord; ami iha jani — I know this; tomara adhika — greater than You; tora pada duikhani — are Your two feet

183'You are the all-pervading Lord, this I know;
but greater than You [Yourself] are Your two feet.

যে পড়িল পদ-নখ-চন্দ্রিকার পাশে ।
আর কি কহিব গুণ মুখে নাহি আসে ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

ye paṛila pada-nakha-candrikāra pāśe |
āra ki kahiba guṇa mukhe nāhi āse || 184 ||

ye padila — whoever has fallen; pada-nakha-chandrikara pashe — into the noose of the moonlight of the toenails; ara ki kahiba — what more shall I say; guna — [his] glory; mukhe nahi ase — does not come to the lips

184Whoever is caught in the net of the moonlight of Your toenails —
what more can I say? — his glory cannot be put into words.'

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (11.6.46):

ত্বয়োপভুক্তস্রগ্গন্ধবাসোঽলঙ্কারচর্চিতাঃ ।
উচ্ছিষ্টভোজিনো দাসাস্তব মায়াং জয়েম হি ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

tbaẏopabhuktasraggandhabāso'laṅkāracarcitāḥ |
ucchiṣṭabhojino dāsāstaba māẏāṃ jaẏema hi || 185 ||

tvaya upabhukta — enjoyed by You; srak-gandha-vasah-alankara — garlands, scents, garments, ornaments; charchitah — adorned with; uchchhishta-bhojinah — eating the remnants; dasah — servants; tava mayam — Your maya; jayema hi — we shall surely conquer

185"Adorned with the garlands, scents, garments and ornaments that You have enjoyed,
we, Your servants who eat Your remnants, shall surely conquer Your maya."8

মোর বল—উচ্ছিষ্ট ভুঞ্জিয়া হরিদাস ।
তোর মায়া জিনি তোর উচ্ছিষ্টের আশ ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

mora bala—ucchiṣṭa bhuñjiẏā haridāsa |
tora māẏā jini tora ucchiṣṭera āśa || 186 ||

mora bala — my strength; uchchhishta bhunjiya — eating the remnants; hari-dasa — Hari's servant; tora maya jini — I conquer Your maya; tora uchchhishtera asha — my hope is Your remnants

186'My strength is this: I, Hari's servant, eat the remnants;
I conquer Your maya — all my hope is in Your remnants.'

এছন ঠাকুর আর উদ্ধবের কথা ।
শুনিঞা হৃদয়ে মোর লাগি গেল ব্যথা ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

echana ṭhākura āra uddhabera kathā |
śuniñā hṛdaẏe mora lāgi gela byathā || 187 ||

echhana — such; thakura ara uddhavera katha — talk of the Lord and Uddhava; shuniya — hearing; hridaye mora — in my heart; lagi gela vyatha — pain arose

187Hearing such a conversation of the Thakura and Uddhava,
I felt pain in my heart:

এতদিন ধরি মোর পথ-পরিচয় ।
আজিহ না জানি হেন উচ্ছিষ্ট নিশ্চয় ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

etadina dhari mora patha-paricaẏa |
ājiha nā jāni hena ucchiṣṭa niścaẏa || 188 ||

etadina dhari — all this time; mora patha-parichaya — I have known the path; ajiha na jani — yet till today I did not know; hena uchchhishta — such remnants; nishchaya — for certain

188for so long I have known the path [of bhakti],
yet until today I did not know for certain [the power of] such remnants.

উচ্ছিষ্টের বলে হরিদাস বল ধরে ।
প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে উচ্ছিষ্টের পুরস্কারে ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

ucchiṣṭera bale haridāsa bala dhare |
prabhu-bidyamāne ucchiṣṭera puraskāre || 189 ||

uchchhishtera bale — by the strength of the remnants; hari-dasa bala dhare — Hari's servant holds power; prabhu-vidyamane — in the Lord's presence; uchchhishtera puraskare — honouring the remnants

189By the strength of the remnants Hari's servant gains strength —
that is why in the Lord's presence he praised them so.9

হেন মহাপ্রসাদ মুঞি না ভুঞ্জিলুঁ কভু ।
অন্তরে জানিলুঁ মোরে বঞ্চিয়াছে প্রভু ॥ ১৯০ ॥

hena mahāprasāda muñi nā bhuñjiluṁ kabhu |
antare jāniluṁ more bañciẏāche prabhu || 190 ||

hena mahaprasada — such mahaprasada; munji na bhunjilun kabhu — I never tasted; antare janilun — I realized within; more vanchiyachhe prabhu — the Lord has deprived me

190Such mahaprasada I have never tasted —
I realized in my heart that the Lord had deprived me.

এই মহাপ্রসাদ ভুঞ্জিয়ে কোন্ বুদ্ধি ।
কেমন উপায়ে পরসন্ন হবে বিধি ॥ ১৯১ ॥

ei mahāprasāda bhuñjiẏe kon buddhi |
kemana upāẏe parasanna habe bidhi || 191 ||

ei mahaprasada — this mahaprasada; bhunjiye — I may eat; kon buddhi — by what device; kemana upaye — by what means; parasanna habe vidhi — will fate be favourable

191How might I taste this mahaprasada?
By what means could I win fate's favour?

এই মনঃকথা-রসে বৈকুণ্ঠেরে গেলুঁ ।
লখিমীদেবীর সেবা বহুবিধ কৈলুঁ ॥ ১৯২ ॥

ei manaḥkathā-rase baikuṇṭhere geluṁ |
lakhimīdebīra sebā bahubidha kailuṁ || 192 ||

ei manah-katha-rase — absorbed in this thought; vaikunthere gelun — I went to Vaikuntha; lakhimi-devira seva — service to Lakshmi-devi; bahuvidha kailun — I did in many ways

192Absorbed in this thought, I went to Vaikuntha
and served Lakshmi-devi in every way.

পরসন্ন হঞা দেবী পরিতোষে বৈল ।
"মাগ বর দিব" বলি প্রতিজ্ঞা করিল ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

parasanna hañā debī paritoṣe baila |
"māga bara diba" bali pratijñā karila || 193 ||

parasanna haina — being pleased; devi paritoshe baila — the goddess said in satisfaction; maga bara — ask a boon; diba — I shall give; bali pratijna karila — saying so, she vowed

193The goddess, pleased, said graciously:
'Ask a boon — I shall give it,' and she made a vow.

প্রতিজ্ঞা শুনিঞা হিয়া প্রতি-আশ কৈল ।
সেই সে কুশল-বাণী পুনঃ দঢ়াইল ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

pratijñā śuniñā hiẏā prati-āśa kaila |
sei se kuśala-bāṇī punaḥ daṛhāila || 194 ||

pratijna shuniya — hearing the vow; hiya prati-asha kaila — my heart took hope; sei se kushala-vani — those very kind words; punah dadhaila — I had her confirm again

194Hearing the vow, my heart took hope,
and I had her confirm those kind words once more.

কাতর-বয়ানে বৈলুঁ করযোড় করি ।
চিরদিন অন্তরে বেদনা বড় মোরি ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

kātara-baẏāne bailuṁ karayoṛa kari |
ciradina antare bedanā baṛa mori || 195 ||

katara-bayane — with a pleading voice; bailun — I said; karayoda kari — with folded palms; chiradina antare — for long in my heart; vedana bada mori — I have great pain

195With a pleading voice and folded palms I said:
'For long there has been a great pain in my heart.

সর্বজন জানে—তোর সেবক নারদ ।
না ভুঞ্জিল মহাপ্রভুর উচ্ছিষ্ট-প্রসাদ ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

sarbajana jāne—tora sebaka nārada |
nā bhuñjila mahāprabhura ucchiṣṭa-prasāda || 196 ||

sarvajana jane — everyone knows; tora sevaka narada — Narada is your servant; na bhunjila — he has not tasted; mahaprabhura uchchhishta-prasada — the remnants of the Great Lord's meal

196Everyone knows that Narada is your servant,
yet he has not tasted the remnants of the Great Lord's meal.10

প্রভুর প্রসাদ মোরে দেহ একমুষ্টি ।
এই বর দেহ মোরে চাহি শুভদৃষ্টি ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

prabhura prasāda more deha ekamuṣṭi |
ei bara deha more cāhi śubhadṛṣṭi || 197 ||

prabhura prasada — the Lord's prasada; more deha ekamushti — give me a handful; ei bara deha more — give me this boon; chahi shubha-drishti — looking [on me] kindly

197Give me a handful of the Lord's prasada —
this is the boon I ask; look on me with kindness.'

শুনিঞা লখিমীদেবী বয়ান-বিস্ময় ।
কহিতে লাগিলা কিছু করিয়া বিনয় ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

śuniñā lakhimīdebī baẏāna-bismaẏa |
kahite lāgilā kichu kariẏā binaẏa || 198 ||

shuniya — hearing; lakhimi-devi — Lakshmi-devi; bayana-vismaya — her face showing surprise; kahite lagila kichhu — began to say; kariya vinaya — humbly

198Hearing this, Lakshmi-devi, astonished,
began to speak humbly:

প্রভু-আজ্ঞা নাহি কারে দিবারে উচ্ছিষ্ট ।
আজ্ঞা লঙ্ঘি মুনি তোরে দিব অবশিষ্ট ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

prabhu-ājñā nāhi kāre dibāre ucchiṣṭa |
ājñā laṅghi muni tore diba abaśiṣṭa || 199 ||

prabhu-ajna nahi — there is no order of the Lord; kare dibare uchchhishta — to give anyone the remnants; ajna langhi — transgressing the order; muni — O sage; tore diba avashishta — shall I give you the remnants?

199'There is no order of the Lord to give His remnants to anyone;
how can I, O sage, transgress His order and give you the remnants?

বিলম্ব করহ কিছু আমারে চাহিয়া ।
বিলম্বে সে দিতে পারি সঞ্চয় করিয়া ॥ ২০০ ॥

bilamba karaha kichu āmāre cāhiẏā |
bilambe se dite pāri sañcaẏa kariẏā || 200 ||

vilamba karaha kichhu — wait a while; amare chahiya — for my sake; vilambe se — in time; dite pari — I can give; sanchaya kariya — having saved some

200Wait a little for my sake:
in time I may be able to give, having saved [some].'

এছন মধুর বাণী বৈল ঠাকুরাণী ।
ভাল ভাল বৈলুঁ কাজ বুঝিয়া আপনি ॥ ২০১ ॥

echana madhura bāṇī baila ṭhākurāṇī |
bhāla bhāla bailuṁ kāja bujhiẏā āpani || 201 ||

echhana madhura vani — such sweet words; baila thakurani — the queen spoke; bhala bhala bailun — I said, "Good, good"; kaja bujhiya apani — understanding the matter myself

201So sweetly the queen spoke;
I answered, 'Good, good,' understanding the matter myself.

কথোদিন বহি একদিন পঁহু রসে ।
কর পরশিয়া দেবী বসাইলা পাশে ॥ ২০২ ॥

kathodina bahi ekadina paṁhu rase |
kara paraśiẏā debī basāilā pāśe || 202 ||

katho-dina vahi — some days having passed; ekadina — one day; panhu rase — the Lord in a loving mood; kara parashiya — touching her hand; devi basaila pashe — seated the goddess beside Him

202Some days passed, and one day the Lord, in a tender mood,
took the goddess by the hand and seated her beside Him.

হাসিয়া কহয়ে কথা সরস সম্ভাষে ।
অনুমতি লঞা দেবী অন্তর-তরাসে ॥ ২০৩ ॥

hāsiẏā kahaẏe kathā sarasa sambhāṣe |
anumati lañā debī antara-tarāse || 203 ||

hasiya kahaye katha — smiling, He talks; sarasa sambhashe — in tender conversation; anumati lana — taking leave [to speak]; devi — the goddess; antara-tarase — with fear at heart

203Smiling, He talks lovingly with her;
the goddess, asking leave to speak, with fear at heart,

প্রণতি করিয়া বৈল—নিবেদন আছে ।
হৃদয়-তরাস মোর সঙ্কট সঙ্কোচে ॥ ২০৪ ॥

praṇati kariẏā baila—nibedana āche |
hṛdaẏa-tarāsa mora saṅkaṭa saṅkoce || 204 ||

pranati kariya — bowing; baila — she said; nivedana achhe — I have a petition; hridaya-tarasa mora — my heart is afraid; sankata sankoche — in distress and shyness

204bowed and said: 'I have a petition;
my heart is afraid — I am in distress and abashed.

সঙ্কট ঘুচাহ প্রভু রাখ নিজ দাসী ।
চরণে ধরিয়া বোলোঁ শুন গুণরাশি ॥ ২০৫ ॥

saṅkaṭa ghucāha prabhu rākha nija dāsī |
caraṇe dhariẏā boloṁ śuna guṇarāśi || 205 ||

sankata ghuchaha — remove the trouble; prabhu — Lord; rakha nija dasi — protect Your maidservant; charane dhariya bolon — I speak clasping Your feet; shuna gunarashi — hear, treasury of virtues

205Remove my trouble, Lord, protect Your maidservant;
clasping Your feet I beg: hear me, treasury of virtues.'

লখিমী কাতরে কহে প্রভুকে তরাসে ।
সুদর্শন-পানে চাহে সবিস্ময় হাসে ॥ ২০৬ ॥

lakhimī kātare kahe prabhuke tarāse |
sudarśana-pāne cāhe sabismaẏa hāse || 206 ||

lakhimi katare kahe — Lakshmi speaks piteously; prabhuke tarase — to the Lord in fear; sudarshana-pane chahe — [He] looks at Sudarshana; savismaya hase — with a surprised smile

206Lakshmi speaks piteously to the Lord, in fear;
He looks at Sudarshana with a surprised smile.11

কাঁপে চক্র সুদর্শন বলে কাকুবাণী ।
লখিমী-সঙ্কট প্রভু আমি নাহি জানি ॥ ২০৭ ॥

kāṁpe cakra sudarśana bale kākubāṇī |
lakhimī-saṅkaṭa prabhu āmi nāhi jāni || 207 ||

kanpe chakra sudarshana — the disc Sudarshana trembles; bale kaku-vani — speaks pleadingly; lakhimi-sankata — of Lakshmi's trouble; prabhu — Lord; ami nahi jani — I know nothing

207The disc Sudarshana trembles and says pleadingly:
'Lord, I know nothing of Lakshmi's trouble.'

লখিমী কহয়ে—সুদর্শনের নাহি দোষ ।
নারদের কথায় মোর হৈল হিয়া-শোষ ॥ ২০৮ ॥

lakhimī kahaẏe—sudarśanera nāhi doṣa |
nāradera kathāẏa mora haila hiẏā-śoṣa || 208 ||

lakhimi kahaye — Lakshmi says; sudarshanera nahi dosha — Sudarshana is not at fault; naradera kathaya — because of Narada's words; mora haila hiya-shosha — my heart has withered

208Lakshmi says: 'Sudarshana is not to blame:
because of Narada's words my heart has withered.

দ্বাদশ বৎসর মোর অজ্ঞাত-সেবা কৈল ।
পরিতোষ পাঞা আমি প্রতিজ্ঞা করিল ॥ ২০৯ ॥

dbādaśa batsara mora ajñāta-sebā kaila |
paritoṣa pāñā āmi pratijñā karila || 209 ||

dvadasha vatsara — for twelve years; mora ajnata-seva kaila — he served me without my knowing [why]; paritosha pana — being pleased; ami pratijna karila — I made a vow

209For twelve years he served me without revealing [his aim];
pleased, I made a vow —

মাগ বর দিব বলি বৈলুঁ সত্য সত্য ।
পুনঃ দঢ়াইল মুনি সেই কথা নিত্য ॥ ২১০ ॥

māga bara diba bali bailuṁ satya satya |
punaḥ daṛhāila muni sei kathā nitya || 210 ||

maga bara diba bali — saying "Ask a boon, I shall give"; bailun satya satya — I said, "Truly, truly"; punah dadhaila muni — the sage made it fast again; sei katha nitya — that word for ever

210"Ask a boon, I shall give it," I said: "Truly, truly";
and the sage made that word fast for ever.

মাগিল যে বর তোর উচ্ছিষ্টের তরে ।
মোর শক্তি কিবা তোর আজ্ঞা লঙ্ঘিবারে ॥ ২১১ ॥

māgila ye bara tora ucchiṣṭera tare |
mora śakti kibā tora ājñā laṅghibāre || 211 ||

magila ye bara — the boon he asked; tora uchchhishtera tare — is for Your remnants; mora shakti kiba — what power have I; tora ajna langhibare — to transgress Your order

211The boon he asked is Your remnants;
but what power have I to transgress Your order?

এই কথা কৈলুঁ মোর প্রমাদ নিকট ।
রাখ নিজ দাসী প্রভু ঘুচাহ সঙ্কট ॥ ২১২ ॥

ei kathā kailuṁ mora pramāda nikaṭa |
rākha nija dāsī prabhu ghucāha saṅkaṭa || 212 ||

ei katha kailun — I have told this; mora pramada nikata — calamity is near me; rakha nija dasi — protect Your maidservant; prabhu — Lord; ghuchaha sankata — remove the trouble

212So I have told You — calamity is upon me;
protect Your maidservant, Lord, remove my trouble.'

বুঝিয়া কহিল কথা—শুনহ লখিমী ।
বড়ই প্রমাদ-কথা কহিলে যে তুমি ॥ ২১৩ ॥

bujhiẏā kahila kathā—śunaha lakhimī |
baṛai pramāda-kathā kahile ye tumi || 213 ||

bujhiya — understanding; kahila katha — He said; shunaha lakhimi — listen, Lakshmi; badai pramada-katha — a very grave matter; kahile ye tumi — is what you have told

213Understanding all, He said: 'Listen, Lakshmi:
a very grave matter is what you have told.

নিভৃতে সে দিহ যেন আমি নাহি জানি ।
শুনিঞা সন্তোষ পাইল প্রভু-আজ্ঞাবাণী ॥ ২১৪ ॥

nibhṛte se diha yena āmi nāhi jāni |
śuniñā santoṣa pāila prabhu-ājñābāṇī || 214 ||

nibhrite se diha — give it in secret; yena ami nahi jani — so that I do not know; shuniya — hearing; santosha paila — she was glad; prabhu-ajna-vani — the Lord's words of leave

214Give it to him in secret — so that I do not know.'
Hearing the Lord's words of leave, she was glad.

কথোদিন রহি সেই জগত-জননী ।
মহাপ্রসাদ মোরে দিলা ডাক দিয়া আনি ॥ ২১৫ ॥

kathodina rahi sei jagata-jananī |
mahāprasāda more dilā ḍāka diẏā āni || 215 ||

kathodina rahi — after some days; sei jagata-janani — that Mother of the world; mahaprasada more dila — gave me mahaprasada; dak diya ani — calling me to her

215After some days that Mother of the world
called me and gave me mahaprasada.

লখিমী-প্রসাদে মহাপ্রসাদ পাইনু ।
পূর্ণ মনোরথে মহাপ্রসাদ ভুঞ্জিনু ॥ ২১৬ ॥

lakhimī-prasāde mahāprasāda pāinu |
pūrṇa manorathe mahāprasāda bhuñjinu || 216 ||

lakhimi-prasade — by Lakshmi's grace; mahaprasada painu — I obtained mahaprasada; purna manorathe — my desire fulfilled; mahaprasada bhunjinu — I ate the mahaprasada

216By Lakshmi's grace I obtained mahaprasada
and, my desire fulfilled, I ate the mahaprasada.

কোটি-ইন্দু-জিনি জ্যোতিঃ কোটি-কামরূপ ।
কোটি-দিবাকর-তেজঃ হৈল অপরূপ ॥ ২১৭ ॥

koṭi-indu-jini jyotiḥ koṭi-kāmarūpa |
koṭi-dibākara-tejaḥ haila aparūpa || 217 ||

koti-indu-jini jyotih — light surpassing millions of moons; koti-kama-rupa — beauty of millions of Kamadevas; koti-divakara-tejah — splendour of millions of suns; haila aparupa — became wondrous

217A light surpassing millions of moons, the beauty of millions of Kamadevas,
the splendour of millions of suns — so wondrous did I become.

শতগুণ তেজঃ মহাপ্রসাদ-পরশে ।
বীণা বাজাইয়া সুখে আইনু কৈলাসে ॥ ২১৮ ॥

śataguṇa tejaḥ mahāprasāda-paraśe |
bīṇā bājāiẏā sukhe āinu kailāse || 218 ||

shataguna tejah — a hundredfold splendour; mahaprasada-parashe — by the touch of mahaprasada; vina bajaiya — playing the vina; sukhe ainu kailase — happily I came to Kailasa

218At the touch of mahaprasada my splendour grew a hundredfold;
playing my vina, happy, I came to Kailasa.

আমারে দেখিয়া প্রভু পুছিলা মহেশ ।
হাসিয়া কহিলা—আজি অপরূপ বেশ ॥ ২১৯ ॥

āmāre dekhiẏā prabhu puchilā maheśa |
hāsiẏā kahilā—āji aparūpa beśa || 219 ||

amare dekhiya — seeing me; prabhu puchhila mahesha — lord Mahesha asked; hasiya kahila — smiling he said; aji aparupa vesha — today [you have] a wondrous look

219Seeing me, lord Mahesha
said with a smile: 'What a wondrous look you have today!

অতি অপরূপ তেজঃ দেখিতে বিস্ময় ।
আজি কেনে হেন রূপ কহ না নিশ্চয় ॥ ২২০ ॥

ati aparūpa tejaḥ dekhite bismaẏa |
āji kene hena rūpa kaha nā niścaẏa || 220 ||

ati aparupa tejah — most wondrous splendour; dekhite vismaya — amazing to see; aji kene hena rupa — why such a form today; kaha na nishchaya — do tell me truly

220Your splendour is so wondrous that it amazes the eye;
why do you have such a form today? Tell me truly.'

আদ্য-অন্ত যত কথা সকলি কহিল ।
শুনিঞা মহেশ পুনঃ আমারে গঞ্জিল ॥ ২২১ ॥

ādya-anta yata kathā sakali kahila |
śuniñā maheśa punaḥ āmāre gañjila || 221 ||

adya-anta yata katha — all from first to last; sakali kahila — I told everything; shuniya mahesha — hearing, Mahesha; punah amare ganjila — then reproached me

221I told him everything from first to last;
having heard it, Mahesha reproached me:

এছন দুর্লভ মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া ।
একেলা ভুঞ্জিলা মুনি আমারে না দিয়া ॥ ২২২ ॥

echana durlabha mahāprasāda pāiẏā |
ekelā bhuñjilā muni āmāre nā diẏā || 222 ||

echhana durlabha mahaprasada — such rare mahaprasada; paiya — having got; ekela bhunjila — you ate it alone; muni — O sage; amare na diya — without giving me any

222'Having got such rare mahaprasada,
you, O sage, ate it alone without giving me any!

আমা দেখিবারে পুনঃ আসিয়াছ প্রেমে ।
এহেন দুর্লভ ধন নাহি আন কেনে ॥ ২২৩ ॥

āmā dekhibāre punaḥ āsiẏācha preme |
ehena durlabha dhana nāhi āna kene || 223 ||

ama dekhibare — to see me; punah asiyachha preme — you have come again with love; ehena durlabha dhana — so rare a treasure; nahi ana kene — why did you not bring?

223You have come again with love to see me —
why did you not bring so rare a treasure?'

শুনিঞা মহেশ-বাণী লজ্জিত হইয়া ।
নমিত-নয়ানে চাহে নখে নখ দিয়া ॥ ২২৪ ॥

śuniñā maheśa-bāṇī lajjita haiẏā |
namita-naẏāne cāhe nakhe nakha diẏā || 224 ||

shuniya mahesha-vani — hearing Mahesha's words; lajjita haiya — ashamed; namita-nayane chahe — he looks with lowered eyes; nakhe nakha diya — rubbing nail on nail

224Hearing Mahesha's words, ashamed,
[I] look down with lowered eyes, rubbing nail against nail.

আছে মহাপ্রসাদ-কণা বলি দিল সুখে ।
পাছু না গণিল প্রভু দিল নিজ মুখে ॥ ২২৫ ॥

āche mahāprasāda-kaṇā bali dila sukhe |
pāchu nā gaṇila prabhu dila nija mukhe || 225 ||

achhe mahaprasada-kana — "there is a particle of mahaprasada"; bali dila sukhe — saying so, I gave it gladly; pachhu na ganila — without a second thought; prabhu — the lord; dila nija mukhe — put it in his mouth

225'There is a particle of mahaprasada,' I said, and gladly gave it;
without a second thought the lord put it into his mouth.

আনন্দে নাচয়ে মহা মহেশঠাকুর ।
পদতল-তলে মহী করে দুরদুর ॥ ২২৬ ॥

ānande nācaẏe mahā maheśaṭhākura |
padatala-tale mahī kare duradura || 226 ||

anande nachaye — dances in bliss; maha mahesha-thakura — the great lord Mahesha; padatala-tale — under the soles of his feet; mahi kare duradura — the earth shudders

226In bliss the great lord Mahesha dances —
beneath his feet the earth shudders.

প্রেম-ভরে টলমল সুমেরু-পর্বত ।
কম্পমানা বসুমতী চমক সর্বত্র ॥ ২২৭ ॥

prema-bhare ṭalamala sumeru-parbata |
kampamānā basumatī camaka sarbatra || 227 ||

prema-bhare — under the weight of prema; talamala — sways; sumeru-parvata — Mount Sumeru; kampamana vasumati — the earth trembles; chamaka sarvatra — alarm everywhere

227Under the weight of prema Mount Sumeru sways,
the earth trembles, alarm is everywhere.

প্রেমে যোগেশ্বর কাঁপে আপনা পাসরে ।
রসাতল যায় মহী মহেশের ভরে ॥ ২২৮ ॥

preme yogeśbara kāṁpe āpanā pāsare |
rasātala yāẏa mahī maheśera bhare || 228 ||

preme — in prema; yogeshvara kanpe — the lord of yoga trembles; apana pasare — forgets himself; rasatala yaya mahi — the earth sinks to Rasatala; maheshera bhare — under Mahesha's weight

228The lord of yoga trembles in prema, forgetting himself;
under Mahesha's weight the earth sinks to Rasatala.

অনন্তের ফণা ঠেকে কচ্ছপের পৃষ্ঠে ।
গ্রীবা বক্র করি কূর্ম চাহে একদৃষ্টে ॥ ২২৯ ॥

anantera phaṇā ṭheke kacchapera pṛṣṭhe |
grībā bakra kari kūrma cāhe ekadṛṣṭe || 229 ||

anantera phana — Ananta's hoods; theke kachchhapera prishthe — press on the Tortoise's back; griva vakra kari — bending his neck; kurma chahe ekadrishte — Kurma stares fixedly

229Ananta's hoods press against the Tortoise's back;
bending his neck, Kurma stares fixedly [upward].12

বক্রগ্রীবা করে ভরে যত দিগ্বাহ ।
হুহুঙ্কার-নাদে ফাটে ব্রহ্মাণ্ড-কটাহ ॥ ২৩০ ॥

bakragrībā kare bhare yata digbāha |
huhuṅkāra-nāde phāṭe brahmāṇḍa-kaṭāha || 230 ||

vakra-griva kare — bend their necks; bhare — under the weight; yata digvaha — all the bearers of the quarters; huhunkara-nade — with the roar; phate brahmanda-kataha — the shell of the universe cracks

230Under the weight all the bearers of the quarters bend their necks;13
at [Shiva's] roar the shell of the universe cracks.

মহেশের ভর দেবী সহিতে না পারি ।
আস্তে ব্যস্তে গেলা মহেশের পুরী ॥ ২৩১ ॥

maheśera bhara debī sahite nā pāri |
āste byaste gelā maheśera purī || 231 ||

maheshera bhara — Mahesha's weight; devi — the goddess [Earth]; sahite na pari — unable to bear; aste vyaste — in haste; gela maheshera puri — went to Mahesha's abode

231Unable to bear Mahesha's weight, the goddess [Earth]
hurried to Mahesha's abode.

কাত্যায়নী-স্থানে মহী কহে করযুড়ি ।
মহেশের নৃত্য-ভরে প্রাণ আমি ছাড়ি ॥ ২৩২ ॥

kātyāẏanī-sthāne mahī kahe karayuṛi |
maheśera nṛtya-bhare prāṇa āmi chāṛi || 232 ||

katyayani-sthane — to Katyayani; mahi kahe — the Earth says; karayudi — with joined palms; maheshera nritya-bhare — under the weight of Mahesha's dance; prana ami chhadi — I am giving up my life

232With joined palms the Earth says to Katyayani:
'Under the weight of Mahesha's dance I am giving up my life.

প্রতিকার কর যদি সৃষ্টি রাখিবারে ।
প্রমাদ পড়িল দেখি সকল সংসারে ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

pratikāra kara yadi sṛṣṭi rākhibāre |
pramāda paṛila dekhi sakala saṃsāre || 233 ||

pratikara kara — take a remedy; yadi srishti rakhibare — if creation is to be saved; pramada padila dekhi — I see calamity has fallen; sakala samsare — upon the whole world

233Help me, if creation is to be saved:
I see calamity has fallen upon the whole world.'

পৃথিবীর কাতরবাণী শুনিঞা পার্বতী ।
সত্বরে চলিয়া গেলা যথা পশুপতি ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

pṛthibīra kātarabāṇī śuniñā pārbatī |
satbare caliẏā gelā yathā paśupati || 234 ||

prithivira katara-vani — the Earth's piteous words; shuniya parvati — hearing, Parvati; satvare chaliya gela — quickly went; yatha pashupati — to where Pashupati was

234Hearing the Earth's piteous words, Parvati
went quickly to where Pashupati was.

পূর্ণ-রসাবেশে নাচে দেবদেবরায় ।
মহেশ-আবেশ ভাঙ্গে কর্কশ কথায় ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

pūrṇa-rasābeśe nāce debadebarāẏa |
maheśa-ābeśa bhāṅge karkaśa kathāẏa || 235 ||

purna-rasa-aveshe — fully absorbed in rasa; nache deva-deva-raya — the king of gods dances; mahesha-avesha bhange — she breaks Mahesha's trance; karkasha kathaya — with harsh words

235The king of gods dances fully absorbed in rasa;
with harsh words she breaks Mahesha's rapture.

সম্বিৎ হইলা প্রভু দুঃখিত হইয়া ।
কর্কশ-হৃদয়ে বলে পার্বতী দেখিয়া ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

sambit hailā prabhu duḥkhita haiẏā |
karkaśa-hṛdaẏe bale pārbatī dekhiẏā || 236 ||

samvit haila prabhu — the lord came to his senses; duhkhita haiya — grieved; karkasha-hridaye bale — he speaks with a hardened heart; parvati dekhiya — seeing Parvati

236The lord came to his senses, grieved,
and, seeing Parvati, speaks to her harshly:

কি কৈলে কি কৈলে দেবী হেন অবিধান ।
এ আবেশ-ভঙ্গ মোর মরণ সমান ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

ki kaile ki kaile debī hena abidhāna |
e ābeśa-bhaṅga mora maraṇa samāna || 237 ||

ki kaile ki kaile — what have you done, what have you done; devi — goddess; hena avidhana — such an impropriety; e avesha-bhanga mora — this breaking of my rapture; marana samana — is like death

237'What have you done, what have you done, goddess — what an outrage!
To break my rapture is the same as killing me.

তোমা বই রিপু মোর নাহি ত্রিভুবনে ।
এহেন আনন্দ মোর ঘুচাইলে কেনে ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

tomā bai ripu mora nāhi tribhubane |
ehena ānanda mora ghucāile kene || 238 ||

toma vai — besides you; ripu mora nahi — I have no enemy; tribhuvane — in the three worlds; ehena ananda mora — such bliss of mine; ghuchaile kene — why did you end?

238I have no enemy in the three worlds but you:
why did you end such bliss of mine?'

শুনিঞা কাতরে দেবী বোলে আরবার ।
পৃথিবী দেখহ প্রভু সম্মুখে তোমার ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

śuniñā kātare debī bole ārabāra |
pṛthibī dekhaha prabhu sammukhe tomāra || 239 ||

shuniya — hearing; katare devi bole — the goddess says piteously; arabara — again; prithivi dekhaha — look at the Earth; prabhu — lord; sammukhe tomara — before you

239Hearing this, the goddess says piteously again:
'Look, lord, at the Earth before you.

তব পদ-তল-ছলে যায় রসাতল ।
সৃষ্টি নষ্ট হয় তেঞি বৈলুঁ কটূত্তর ॥ ২৪০ ॥

taba pada-tala-chale yāẏa rasātala |
sṛṣṭi naṣṭa haẏa teñi bailuṁ kaṭūttara || 240 ||

taba pada-tala-chhale — under the stamping of your feet; yaya rasatala — she sinks to Rasatala; srishti nashta haya — creation is perishing; tenji bailun katu-uttara — that is why I spoke harshly

240Under the stamping of your feet she is sinking to Rasatala,
creation is perishing — that is why I spoke harshly.

অপরাধ কৈলুঁ দোষ ক্ষম মহাশয় ।
হাসিয়া মহেশ দিলা পৃথিবী-বিদায় ॥ ২৪১ ॥

aparādha kailuṁ doṣa kṣama mahāśaẏa |
hāsiẏā maheśa dilā pṛthibī-bidāẏa || 241 ||

aparadha kailun — I have offended; dosha kshama — forgive the fault; mahashaya — great one; hasiya mahesha — smiling, Mahesha; dila prithivi-vidaya — dismissed the Earth

241I have offended — forgive my fault, great one.'
Smiling, Mahesha dismissed the Earth.

পুনরপি পুছে দেবী মিনতি করিয়া ।
এক নিবেদিয়ে প্রভু সন্দেহ লাগিয়া ॥ ২৪২ ॥

punarapi puche debī minati kariẏā |
eka nibediẏe prabhu sandeha lāgiẏā || 242 ||

punarapi puchhe devi — again the goddess asks; minati kariya — entreating; eka nivediye — I ask one thing; prabhu — lord; sandeha lagiya — because of a doubt

242And again the goddess asks entreatingly:
'Lord, I ask one thing — a doubt troubles me:

কৃষ্ণরসাবেশে তুমি নাচ প্রতিদিনে ।
আজি মহী রসাতল যায় কি কারণে ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

kṛṣṇarasābeśe tumi nāca pratidine |
āji mahī rasātala yāẏa ki kāraṇe || 243 ||

krishna-rasa-aveshe — absorbed in the rasa of Krishna; tumi nacha pratidine — you dance every day; aji — today; mahi rasatala yaya — the earth sinks to Rasatala; ki karane — for what reason

243every day you dance absorbed in the rasa of Krishna —
why then does the earth sink to Rasatala today?

কোটি-দিবাকর-তেজঃ কিরণ প্রচণ্ড ।
অতি অপরূপ তেজঃ না ধরে ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ॥ ২৪৪ ॥

koṭi-dibākara-tejaḥ kiraṇa pracaṇḍa |
ati aparūpa tejaḥ nā dhare brahmāṇḍa || 244 ||

koti-divakara-tejah — the splendour of millions of suns; kirana prachanda — fierce rays; ati aparupa tejah — most wondrous radiance; na dhare brahmanda — the universe cannot hold

244The splendour of millions of suns, fierce rays —
the universe cannot hold so wondrous a radiance.

আজি কেনে অপরূপ আনন্দ অনন্ত ।
সবিশেষ কহ মোরে প্রভু গুণবন্ত ॥ ২৪৫ ॥

āji kene aparūpa ānanda ananta |
sabiśeṣa kaha more prabhu guṇabanta || 245 ||

aji kene — why today; aparupa ananda ananta — wondrous, endless bliss; savishesha kaha more — tell me in detail; prabhu gunavanta — virtuous lord

245Why this wondrous, endless bliss today?
Tell me in detail, lord, rich in virtues.'

মহেশ কহয়ে—শুন আনন্দ-কাহিনী ।
প্রভুর প্রসাদ মোরে দিল মহামুনি ॥ ২৪৬ ॥

maheśa kahaẏe—śuna ānanda-kāhinī |
prabhura prasāda more dila mahāmuni || 246 ||

mahesha kahaye — Mahesha says; shuna ananda-kahini — hear a joyful tale; prabhura prasada — the Lord's prasada; more dila mahamuni — the great sage gave me

246Mahesha says: 'Hear a joyful tale:
the great sage gave me the Lord's prasada.

দুর্লভ এ ত্রিজগতে বিষ্ণু-নিবেদিত ।
বিশেষ অধরামৃত বেদে অবিদিত ॥ ২৪৭ ॥

durlabha e trijagate biṣṇu-nibedita |
biśeṣa adharāmṛta bede abidita || 247 ||

durlabha — rare; e trijagate — in these three worlds; vishnu-nivedita — what is offered to Vishnu; vishesha — still more; adhara-amrita — the nectar of His lips; vede avidita — unknown to the Vedas

247Rare in the three worlds is [a taste of] what is offered to Vishnu,
still more the nectar of His lips, unknown to the Vedas.14

হেন মহাপ্রসাদ আমি করিনু ভক্ষণ ।
সফল জনম মোর আজি শুভক্ষণ ॥ ২৪৮ ॥

hena mahāprasāda āmi karinu bhakṣaṇa |
saphala janama mora āji śubhakṣaṇa || 248 ||

hena mahaprasada — such mahaprasada; ami karinu bhakshana — I have eaten; saphala janama mora — my birth is fruitful; aji shubhakshana — today is an auspicious hour

248Such mahaprasada I have eaten —
my birth is fruitful, this is an auspicious hour.'

নারদ-প্রসাদে মহাপ্রসাদ-পরশ ।
কহিল মঙ্গল কথা সম্পদ সরস ॥ ২৪৯ ॥

nārada-prasāde mahāprasāda-paraśa |
kahila maṅgala kathā sampada sarasa || 249 ||

narada-prasade — by Narada's grace; mahaprasada-parasha — the touch of mahaprasada; kahila mangala katha — he told the auspicious story; sampada sarasa — a delightful treasure

249By Narada's grace — the touch of mahaprasada:
he told her this auspicious story, a delightful treasure.

শুনি ঠাকুরের বাণী কহে মহামায়া ।
এতদিনে জানিল তোমার যত দয়া ॥ ২৫০ ॥

śuni ṭhākurera bāṇī kahe mahāmāẏā |
etadine jānila tomāra yata daẏā || 250 ||

shuni thakurera vani — hearing the lord's words; kahe mahamaya — Mahamaya says; etadine janila — now at last I know; tomara yata daya — how great is your kindness

250Hearing the lord's words, Mahamaya says:15
'Now at last I know how great your kindness is!

অর্ধ অঙ্গে ধর মোরে সকলি কপট ।
কৈতব পিরীতি এবে হইল প্রকট ॥ ২৫১ ॥

ardha aṅge dhara more sakali kapaṭa |
kaitaba pirīti ebe haila prakaṭa || 251 ||

ardha ange dhara more — you hold me as half your body; sakali kapata — it is all deceit; kaitava piriti — false love; ebe haila prakata — now is exposed

251You hold me as half your body — it is all deceit;
now your false love is exposed!

এহেন দুর্লভ মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া ।
একেলা ভুঞ্জিলা দেব আমারে না দিয়া ॥ ২৫২ ॥

ehena durlabha mahāprasāda pāiẏā |
ekelā bhuñjilā deba āmāre nā diẏā || 252 ||

ehena durlabha mahaprasada — such rare mahaprasada; paiya — having got; ekela bhunjila — you ate alone; deva — O god; amare na diya — without giving me

252Having got such rare mahaprasada,
you, god, ate it alone without giving me any!'

লজ্জায় অবশ হঞা বোলে শূলপাণি ।
এ ধনের অধিকারী নহ তুমি ভবানী ॥ ২৫৩ ॥

lajjāẏa abaśa hañā bole śūlapāṇi |
e dhanera adhikārī naha tumi bhabānī || 253 ||

lajjaya avasha haina — helpless with shame; bole shulapani — the Trident-bearer says; e dhanera adhikari — entitled to this treasure; naha tumi bhavani — you are not, Bhavani

253Helpless with shame, the Trident-bearer says:
'This treasure is not for you, Bhavani.'

শুনিঞা রুষিলা হিয়া বোলে আদ্যাশক্তি ।
বৈষ্ণবী নাম মোর করি বিষ্ণুভক্তি ॥ ২৫৪ ॥

śuniñā ruṣilā hiẏā bole ādyāśakti |
baiṣṇabī nāma mora kari biṣṇubhakti || 254 ||

shuniya — hearing; rushila hiya — angered at heart; bole adya-shakti — the primal Shakti says; vaishnavi nama mora — my name is Vaishnavi; kari vishnu-bhakti — I practise devotion to Vishnu

254Hearing this, angered, the primal Shakti says:
'My name is Vaishnavi; I serve Vishnu.

প্রতিজ্ঞা করিলুঁ মুঞি সভার ভিতরে ।
জানিবে আমারে দয়া প্রভুর অন্তরে ॥ ২৫৫ ॥

pratijñā kariluṁ muñi sabhāra bhitare |
jānibe āmāre daẏā prabhura antare || 255 ||

pratijna karilun munji — I make a vow; sabhara bhitare — before all; janibe — you will know; amare daya — the kindness towards me; prabhura antare — in the Lord's heart

255I make a vow before all —
and you will know whether there is kindness for me in the Lord's heart:

এই মহাপ্রসাদ মুঞি দিমু জগতেরে ।
মোর প্রতিজ্ঞায় পাবে শৃগাল-কুক্কুরে ॥ ২৫৬ ॥

ei mahāprasāda muñi dimu jagatere |
mora pratijñāẏa pābe śṛgāla-kukkure || 256 ||

ei mahaprasada — this mahaprasada; munji dimu jagatere — I shall give to the world; mora pratijnaya — by my vow; pabe shrigala-kukkure — even jackals and dogs will receive it

256this mahaprasada I shall give to the whole world —
by my vow even jackals and dogs will receive it.'16

এছন প্রতিজ্ঞা কাত্যায়নী যবে কৈলা ।
শুনিঞা বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ সত্বরে আইলা ॥ ২৫৭ ॥

echana pratijñā kātyāẏanī yabe kailā |
śuniñā baikuṇṭhanātha satbare āilā || 257 ||

echhana pratijna — such a vow; katyayani yabe kaila — when Katyayani made; shuniya — hearing; vaikuntha-natha — the Lord of Vaikuntha; satvare aila — came quickly

257When Katyayani made such a vow,
the Lord of Vaikuntha, hearing it, came quickly.

সম্ভ্রমে উঠিয়া দেবী কৈল পরণাম ।
নিবেদন কৈল দেবী সজল-নয়ান ॥ ২৫৮ ॥

sambhrame uṭhiẏā debī kaila paraṇāma |
nibedana kaila debī sajala-naẏāna || 258 ||

sambhrame uthiya — rising respectfully; devi kaila paranama — the goddess bowed; nivedana kaila devi — the goddess made her plea; sajala-nayana — with tearful eyes

258Rising respectfully, the goddess bowed
and with tearful eyes made her plea to Him;

কাতর-অন্তরে কহে ছাড়িয়া নিঃশ্বাস ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২৫৯ ॥

kātara-antare kahe chāṛiẏā niḥśbāsa |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 259 ||

katara-antare kahe — she speaks with an aching heart; chhadiya nihshvasa — sighing; ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

259with an aching heart, sighing, she speaks —
and with a joyful heart this Lochana Dasa tells it.

Raga vibhasha

বোলে পঁহু লহু বোলে, নহ দেবী উতরোলে,
একি হয় তোর ব্যবহার ।
তোর মায়া-বন্ধে অন্ধ, সকল সংসার-খণ্ড,
তেঞি সৃষ্টি আছয়ে আমার ॥ ২৬০ ॥

bole paṁhu lahu bole, naha debī utarole,
eki haẏa tora byabahāra |
tora māẏā-bandhe andha, sakala saṃsāra-khaṇḍa,
teñi sṛṣṭi āchaẏe āmāra || 260 ||

bole panhu — the Lord says; lahu bole — in soft words; naha devi utarole — do not be agitated, goddess; eki haya tora vyavahara — what kind of conduct is this; tora maya-bandhe andha — blind in the bonds of your maya; sakala samsara-khanda — is the whole world; tenji — therefore; srishti achhaye amara — My creation goes on

260Softly the Lord says: 'Do not be agitated, goddess;
what is this conduct of yours?
The whole world is blind in the bonds of your maya —
that is why My creation goes on.

তুমি মোর আদ্যাশক্তি, তুমি সে জানহ ভক্তি,
তুমি মোর প্রকৃতিস্বরূপা ।
আমি তোমা বহি নহি, তুমি আমা বহি কহি,
যে করহ তোমারি সে কৃপা ॥ ২৬১ ॥

tumi mora ādyāśakti, tumi se jānaha bhakti,
tumi mora prakṛtisbarūpā |
āmi tomā bahi nahi, tumi āmā bahi kahi,
ye karaha tomāri se kṛpā || 261 ||

tumi mora adya-shakti — you are My primal shakti; tumi se janaha bhakti — you know bhakti; tumi mora prakriti-svarupa — you are My prakriti in essence; ami toma vahi nahi — I am not apart from you; tumi ama vahi kahi — [nor] you, I say, apart from Me; ye karaha — whatever you do; tomari se kripa — is your grace

261You are My primal shakti, you know bhakti,
you are by nature My prakriti;
I am not apart from you, nor, I say, are you apart from Me;17
whatever you do is your grace.

হরগৌরী-আরাধনে, সর্বলোক আমা জানে,
হরগৌরী মোর আত্মতনু ।
তোর পরসন্ন হিয়া, ঘুচিল সকল মায়া,
ঘুচিল স্ব-পর-ভেদ ভিনু ॥ ২৬২ ॥

haragaurī-ārādhane, sarbaloka āmā jāne,
haragaurī mora ātmatanu |
tora parasanna hiẏā, ghucila sakala māẏā,
ghucila sba-para-bheda bhinu || 262 ||

hara-gauri-aradhane — by worship of Hara and Gauri; sarvaloka ama jane — all people know Me; hara-gauri mora atma-tanu — Hara and Gauri are My own body; tora parasanna hiya — your heart being pleased; ghuchila sakala maya — all maya is gone; ghuchila sva-para-bheda bhinu — the division of "mine" and "another's" is gone

262By worshipping Hara and Gauri all people come to know Me:
Hara and Gauri are My own body;
when your heart is pleased, all maya vanishes,
the division into 'mine' and 'another's' vanishes.18

এছন প্রতিজ্ঞা তোর, এহেন উচ্ছিষ্ট মোর,
অবিরোধে দিবে সভাকারে ।
মহাপ্রসাদের গন্ধে, সভে হবে মুক্তবন্ধে,
ঘুচাইবে নির্বন্ধ বিচারে ॥ ২৬৩ ॥

echana pratijñā tora, ehena ucchiṣṭa mora,
abirodhe dibe sabhākāre |
mahāprasādera gandhe, sabhe habe muktabandhe,
ghucāibe nirbandha bicāre || 263 ||

echhana pratijna tora — such is your vow; ehena uchchhishta mora — such remnants of Mine; avirodhe dibe sabhakare — you will give to all without hindrance; mahaprasadera gandhe — by the fragrance of mahaprasada; sabhe habe mukta-bandhe — all will be freed from bonds; ghuchaibe nirbandha vichare — it will end restrictive considerations

263Such is your vow — these remnants of Mine
you will give to all without hindrance;
by the mere fragrance of mahaprasada all will be freed from bonds;
it will do away with restrictive rules.

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর-বাণী, পুন কহে কাত্যায়নী,
মোরে যদি দয়া আছে চিতে ।
অবশ্য উচ্ছিষ্ট দিবে, ভুঞ্জিবে সকল জীবে,
অবিরোধে পাবে ত্রিজগতে ॥ ২৬৪ ॥

śuniñā ṭhākura-bāṇī, puna kahe kātyāẏanī,
more yadi daẏā āche cite |
abaśya ucchiṣṭa dibe, bhuñjibe sakala jībe,
abirodhe pābe trijagate || 264 ||

shuniya thakura-vani — hearing the Lord's words; puna kahe katyayani — Katyayani says again; more yadi daya achhe chite — if there is kindness for me in [Your] heart; avashya uchchhishta dibe — surely give the remnants; bhunjibe sakala jive — all beings will eat; avirodhe pabe trijagate — the three worlds will receive without hindrance

264Hearing the Lord's words, Katyayani says again:
'If there is kindness for me in Your heart,
surely give [Your] remnants: let all beings eat them,
let the three worlds receive them without hindrance.'

পুন কহে গুণমণি, শুন দেবী কাত্যায়নি,
প্রতিজ্ঞা পালিব আছে কথা ।
পুরুব-রহস্য এই, তোমারে নিভৃতে কই,
ঘুচিবে সংসার-জ্বর-চিন্তা ॥ ২৬৫ ॥

puna kahe guṇamaṇi, śuna debī kātyāẏani,
pratijñā pāliba āche kathā |
puruba-rahasya ei, tomāre nibhṛte kai,
ghucibe saṃsāra-jbara-cintā || 265 ||

puna kahe gunamani — the Jewel of virtues says again; shuna devi katyayani — hear, goddess Katyayani; pratijna paliba — I shall keep [your] vow; achhe katha — there is a story; puruba-rahasya ei — this is an ancient secret; tomare nibhrite kai — I tell you privately; ghuchibe samsara-jvara-chinta — the anxiety of the fever of worldly life will end

265Again the Jewel of virtues says: 'Hear, goddess Katyayani:
I shall keep your vow — there is a story about it;
it is an ancient secret; I tell it to you privately —
and the anxiety of the fever of worldly life will go.

পুরুব-রহস্য যত, কেহ নাহি জানে তত্ত্ব,
সমুদ্র মথিল দেবগণে ।
মন্দার মথন-দণ্ড, রজ্জু ফণী অনন্ত,
লোম উপজিল ঘরিষণে ॥ ২৬৬ ॥

puruba-rahasya yata, keha nāhi jāne tattba,
samudra mathila debagaṇe |
mandāra mathana-daṇḍa, rajju phaṇī ananta,
loma upajila ghariṣaṇe || 266 ||

puruba-rahasya yata — of this ancient secret; keha nahi jane tattva — no one knows the truth; samudra mathila deva-gane — the gods churned the ocean; mandara mathana-danda — Mandara the churning rod; rajju phani ananta — the serpent Ananta the rope; loma upajila gharishane — from the friction a hair (shoot) arose

266No one knows the truth of this ancient secret:
when the gods churned the ocean —
Mandara the churning rod, the serpent Ananta the rope —
from the friction a shoot arose.19

সে মোর কল্পতরু, যাচক যাচিঞা করু,
যার যত যেই মনে বাসে ।
যে জন যে ধন চাহে, সে জন সে ধন পাহে,
বিমুখ না করে প্রতি-আশে ॥ ২৬৭ ॥

se mora kalpataru, yācaka yāciñā karu,
yāra yata yei mane bāse |
ye jana ye dhana cāhe, se jana se dhana pāhe,
bimukha nā kare prati-āśe || 267 ||

se mora kalpa-taru — that is My wish-fulfilling tree; yachaka yachina karu — let suppliants ask; yara yata yei mane vase — whatever each holds in mind; ye jana ye dhana chahe — whoever wants whatever wealth; se jana se dhana pahe — he gets that wealth; vimukha na kare prati-ashe — it turns none away from his hope

267That is My wish-fulfilling tree: let suppliants ask
whatever each holds in mind;
whoever wants whatever treasure receives that treasure —
it disappoints no one in his hope.

তহিঁ এক দিব্য তেজে, চারু তরুবর-মাঝে,
শ্রীচৈতন্য অধিষ্ঠিত দেহে ।
সে মোর সহজ রূপ, কেবল করুণা-ভূপ,
আর যত সেহ সম নহে ॥ ২৬৮ ॥

tahiṁ eka dibya teje, cāru tarubara-mājhe,
śrīcaitanya adhiṣṭhita dehe |
se mora sahaja rūpa, kebala karuṇā-bhūpa,
āra yata seha sama nahe || 268 ||

tahin eka divya teje — there, in a divine radiance; charu taruvara-majhe — within the beautiful tree; shri-chaitanya adhishthita dehe — Sri Chaitanya is present embodied; se mora sahaja rupa — that is My natural form; kevala karuna-bhupa — a king of pure compassion; ara yata — all others; seha sama nahe — are not equal to Him

268There, in a divine radiance, within that beautiful tree,
Sri Chaitanya is present in bodily form;20
that is My natural form, a king of pure compassion —
all others are not equal to Him.

যত যত অবতার, সেই সে আশ্রয়াগার,
লীলা-কলা-বিলাসের তরে ।
পৃথিবীতে রহিব আমি, ত্রিজগত-নাথ-স্বামী,
করুণা করিব পরচারে ॥ ২৬৯ ॥

yata yata abatāra, sei se āśraẏāgāra,
līlā-kalā-bilāsera tare |
pṛthibīte rahiba āmi, trijagata-nātha-sbāmī,
karuṇā kariba paracāre || 269 ||

yata yata avatara — all the avataras; sei se ashrayagara — He is their abode and shelter; lila-kala-vilasera tare — for pastimes, arts and enjoyment; prithivite rahiba ami — I shall remain on earth; trijagata-natha-svami — Lord and master of the three worlds; karuna kariba parachare — I shall spread mercy

269All the avataras — He is their abode and shelter,21
[from Him they come] for the sake of pastimes, arts and delights.
I shall remain on earth, Lord and master of the three worlds,
and shall spread mercy.

কলিযুগে সবিশেষে, সঙ্কীর্তন-পরকাশে,
হব আমি মনুজ-মূরতি ।
তনু হব হেম-গৌর, প্রতিজ্ঞা পালিব তোর,
প্রচারিব পরম পিরীতি ॥ ২৭০ ॥

kaliyuge sabiśeṣe, saṅkīrtana-parakāśe,
haba āmi manuja-mūrati |
tanu haba hema-gaura, pratijñā pāliba tora,
pracāriba parama pirīti || 270 ||

kali-yuge savisheshe — especially in the Kali-yuga; sankirtana-parakashe — revealing sankirtana; haba ami manuja-murati — I shall take a human form; tanu haba hema-gaura — My body will be golden; pratijna paliba tora — I shall keep your vow; prachariba parama piriti — I shall spread the highest love

270Especially in the Kali-yuga, revealing sankirtana,
I shall take a human form;
My body will be golden; I shall keep your vow
and spread the highest love.

এ মোর অন্তর-হিয়া, তোমারে কহিল ইহা,
সম্বরি রাখহ নিজমনে ।
সব-অবতার-সার, কলি-গোরা-অবতার,
নিস্তারিব লোক নিজগুণে ॥ ২৭১ ॥

e mora antara-hiẏā, tomāre kahila ihā,
sambari rākhaha nijamane |
saba-abatāra-sāra, kali-gorā-abatāra,
nistāriba loka nijaguṇe || 271 ||

e mora antara-hiya — this is the secret of My heart; tomare kahila iha — I have told you; sambari rakhaha nija-mane — keep it guarded in your mind; saba-avatara-sara — the essence of all avataras; kali-gora-avatara — the avatara Gora in Kali; nistariba loka nija-gune — I shall deliver people by My virtues

271This secret of My heart I have told you —
keep it guarded in your mind:
the essence of all avataras, Gora, the avatara of Kali —
by My virtues I shall deliver the people.'"

বিষ্ণু-কাত্যায়নী-সনে, সংবাদ ব্রহ্মপুরাণে,
উৎকলখণ্ডেতে পরকাশ ।
রাজা সে প্রতাপরুদ্র, সর্বগুণের সমুদ্র,
ব্যক্ত কৈল অনেক প্রকাশ ॥ ২৭২ ॥

biṣṇu-kātyāẏanī-sane, saṃbāda brahmapurāṇe,
utkalakhaṇḍete parakāśa |
rājā se pratāparudra, sarbaguṇera samudra,
byakta kaila aneka prakāśa || 272 ||

vishnu-katyayani-sane samvada — the dialogue of Vishnu with Katyayani; brahma-purane — in the Brahma-purana; utkala-khandete parakasha — is set forth in the Utkala-khanda; raja se prataparudra — King Prataparudra; sarva-gunera samudra — an ocean of all virtues; vyakta kaila aneka prakasha — made it widely known

272The dialogue of Vishnu with Katyayani is in the Brahma-purana,
set forth in the Utkala-khanda;
King Prataparudra, an ocean of all virtues,
made it widely known.22

এ কথা তোমার মনে, স্মরণ নাহিক কেনে,
হাসি হাসি বোলে মুনিরাজে ।
প্রভু আজ্ঞা দিল মোরে, ঘোষণা দিবার তরে,
কলিযুগ-অবতার-কাজে ॥ ২৭৩ ॥

e kathā tomāra mane, smaraṇa nāhika kene,
hāsi hāsi bole munirāje |
prabhu ājñā dila more, ghoṣaṇā dibāra tare,
kaliyuga-abatāra-kāje || 273 ||

e katha tomara mane — this in your mind; smarana nahika kene — why do you not remember; hasi hasi bole muniraje — laughing, says the king of sages; prabhu ajna dila more — the Lord ordered me; ghoshana dibara tare — to proclaim; kali-yuga-avatara-kaje — the work of the avatara of the Kali-yuga

273"Why do you not remember this?" —
laughing, says the king of sages. —
"The Lord ordered me to proclaim
the work of the avatara of the Kali-yuga:

সভে কলিযুগ পাঞা, পৃথ্বীতে জনম গিয়া,
নাম-বিপর্যয় নিজ অংশে ।
সেই সব লোকনাথ, সব-পারিষদ-সাথ,
জনম লভিব বিপ্রবংশে ॥ ২৭৪ ॥

sabhe kaliyuga pāñā, pṛthbīte janama giẏā,
nāma-biparyaẏa nija aṃśe |
sei saba lokanātha, saba-pāriṣada-sātha,
janama labhiba biprabaṃśe || 274 ||

sabhe kali-yuga pana — all of you, when the Kali-yuga comes; prithvite janama giya — taking birth on earth; nama-viparyaya — with changed names; nija amshe — as your own portions; sei saba loka-natha — all those lords of the worlds; saba-parishada-satha — with all the associates; janama labhiba vipra-vamshe — will be born in brahmana families

274when the Kali-yuga comes, all of you will be born on earth
as your own portions, under other names;23
all those lords of the worlds, with all the associates,

275Hearing Narada's words, the Trident-bearer rejoiced,
the goddess Katyayani rejoiced;
the abode filled with joy, all say "Hari, Hari!" —
a joyful clamour arose.

✦

Notes

  1. A reference to the source of the dialogue, the Jaimini-bharata (v. 155). Which text by this name Lochana Dasa has in mind is unclear.
  2. Malasat: slapping the shoulders and thighs with the palms, as wrestlers do to challenge an opponent; in the Gaudiya biographies one of the signs of ecstatic rapture.
  3. Narada humbly names the grace of Katyayani (Parvati) and Shiva as the source of his devotion. For Gaudiya Vaishnavas Shiva is the best of Vaishnavas (Bhag. 12.13.16); so Bhaktisiddhanta also calls him in his summary of this section.
  4. Nandi and Mahakala are Shiva's servants and doorkeepers.
  5. V. 172+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition it is in a footnote, as an additional reading of one printed book. In the 1983 edition the first line of v. 172 also differs: "He embraces [him] tightly with joy in his heart" — without the words "seated him beside himself". The text does not say who leads Narada — Shiva or the goddess.
  6. The conversation of Uddhava with the Lord before His departure is in the Bhagavata, canto 11 (11.6.43–50 and the following Uddhava-gita, where the Lord explains yoga). Literally "explained yoga concerning His own doings".
  7. Cf. the Bhagavad-gita, chs. 7 and 10. The Lord pervades everything by His energies and dwells in all as the Paramatma, while remaining a person distinct from creation and inconceivably one with it (achintya-bhedabheda); there is no identification of God with the world here.
  8. In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition every quoted shloka is followed by his prose order of the words (anvaya) and a Bengali translation; on this page they are almost illegible. "Your maya" is the external energy of the Lord, which holds living beings captive; the Lord Himself is not subject to it.
  9. "Hari's servant" (hari-dasa) here is Uddhava.
  10. "The Great Lord" (mahaprabhu) here is Narayana, the Lord of Vaikuntha, not Sri Chaitanya.
  11. Sudarshana is the Lord's disc, the guardian of His apartments; the Lord wonders whether he has offended Lakshmi.
  12. The earth is upheld beneath by the serpent Ananta (Shesha) on his hoods, and beneath him by the Tortoise (Kurma).
  13. "The bearers of the quarters" (digvaha): the diggajas, the elephants said to support the world in the eight directions.
  14. "The nectar of His lips" (adharamrita): the remnants of food touched by the Lord's lips; this is mahaprasada in the proper sense.
  15. Mahamaya is a name of Parvati (Durga). For Gaudiya Vaishnavas Durga is the external energy of the Lord, carrying out His will as a shadow follows the movements of the body (Brahma-samhita 5.44); below the Lord Himself calls her His shakti (vv. 260–261).
  16. Cf. the tradition of Puri: everything offered to Jagannatha is then offered to Vimala-devi (Parvati) in Jagannatha's temple, and only then becomes the mahaprasada that is given to all without distinction.
  17. An energy is inseparable from its possessor (shakti and shaktiman). In the Gaudiya understanding Durga is the external energy of the Lord (bahiranga-shakti, maya), the shadow of His internal energy (chit-shakti) to which Radha and the eternal consorts belong; the Lord Himself is not subject to maya — she serves His will, keeping captive those who have turned from Him.
  18. So Lochana Dasa: "Hara and Gauri are My own body." According to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching Shiva is not different from the Lord in source, but, in contact with tamo-guna, becomes distinct, as milk turned into curd (Brahma-samhita 5.45); Durga is the Lord's external energy (5.44). "The division into mine and another's" is the false "I" and "mine" (cf. v. 35) created by maya; there is no question of the difference between the soul and God disappearing.
  19. Literally "a hair" (loma); from the following verses, the shoot from which the wish-fulfilling tree (kalpa-taru) grew (cf. the Parijata, which came out of the churned ocean).
  20. Lochana Dasa probably connects this tree with the Kalpa-vata, the sacred banyan by Jagannatha's temple in Puri, honoured as a wish-fulfilling tree; the whole dialogue (v. 272) comes from the traditions of Utkala (Orissa) and Purushottama-kshetra.
  21. Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 2: Krishna (and Gaura as Krishna) is the avatari, the source of all avataras.
  22. The Utkala-khanda is the account of Purushottama-kshetra (Puri) known as part of the Skanda-purana; a Purushottama account is also found in the Brahma-purana. Prataparudra was the king of Orissa (reigned c. 1497–1540), a devotee of Sri Chaitanya. What exactly Prataparudra did to spread this account is not clear from the text.
  23. Cf. Kavi Karnapura's Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika, which states which eternal associates and gods appeared as whom in Gaura-lila. The words "in brahmana families" are the author's generalization: not all the Lord's associates were brahmanas by birth (Murari Gupta, for example, was a vaidya, and Haridasa Thakura was born in a Muslim family).
